title: daphne altaica subsp. fasciculiflora
intro: Daphne altaica subsp. fasciculiflora, commonly known as  Eastern Daphne, is a plant species within the Daphne genus, characterized by its compact growth habit and clusters of small, white flowers. The Eastern Daphne is valued for its therapeutic properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects that promote wound healing, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The plant's bioactive constituents, such as daphnetin and daphnodorin, contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antiviral and antifungal properties. The health benefits of Eastern Daphne include its potential to reduce pain and inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
